progress.connecting: Connecting to the mirror cabinet and replaying the observed Schneider session initialization

prepare_pairing.title: Put the mirror cabinet into pairing mode
prepare_pairing.description:
Before Home Assistant scans, press the physical pairing/learn button on the light or mirror cabinet now. Keep the device powered and close to the Bluetooth proxy, then press **Continue**. Home Assistant will immediately run a fresh active Bluetooth scan.

PacketLogger shows no standard BLE SMP pairing in the captured Schneider app session, so Home Assistant does not call Bluetooth `pair()`. The physical button is treated as a device-side discovery/authorization step.

select_device.title: Select Schneider/WSC device
select_device.description: More than one compatible device was found during the fresh scan. Select the mirror cabinet you want to add.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant automatically discovered **{name}**. If you have not already done so, press the physical pairing/learn button on the light or mirror cabinet, then press **Continue**. Home Assistant will verify the GATT connection before saving the device.

no_devices.title: No Schneider/WSC device found
no_devices.description: The fresh Bluetooth scan did not see a compatible Schneider/WSC device. Check that a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online and close to the mirror cabinet. Press the physical pairing/learn button on the cabinet, then choose **Retry** to start a new scan.

connect_failed.title: Could not initialize the mirror cabinet
connect_failed.description: Home Assistant found the device but could not complete the connection and the observed Schneider initialization sequence. Press the physical pairing/learn button again, make sure the ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online and nearby, then choose **Retry**. No configuration entry was saved.

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported by this integration.
